value_stream.name: Sales Enablement, Product Knowledge Mastery & Clienteling

fields.Participants: Sales Enablement, Analytics (links to VS-28.1), Store Ops (links to VS-07), Merchandising (links to VS-01), Finance (links to VS-17.4), People Analytics (links to VS-103.3), HR (links to VS-19)

workflows.name: Selling-Effectiveness KPI Framework & Associate/Store Performance Scorecard

Automation Opportunity: - workflow automation; system-driven processing with exception handling
Controls: - CTL-603 (ensure controlled execution — Selling Performance, Attachment & Clienteling Analytics (PA-124.3).)
- operational: balanced scorecard; operational: fairness controls and RA 10173 (links to VS-91)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Metric-gaming risk**: Associates game narrow metrics; mitigated by balanced scorecard
- **Fairness/privacy risk**: Associate-level metrics misused or unlawfully handled; mitigated by fairness controls and RA 10173 (links to VS-91)
System Touchpoints: - Analytics/BI (links to VS-28.1); POS data (links to VS-08); people analytics (links to VS-103.3); data privacy (links to VS-91); labor relations (links to VS-84); recognition (links to W3838)

steps.activity: Sales Enablement/Analytics define the selling-effectiveness KPI framework: basket size/units, conversion, attach rate (service/accessory/link-sell), trade-pro identification, loyalty enrollment/identification, product-knowledge certification coverage (links to W3842), and selling-quality score (links to W3847), at store/department/associate level where data permits

Sales Enablement/Analytics produce store/department/associate selling scorecards (with appropriate fairness, data-quality, and privacy controls — links to VS-91), and feed into coaching (links to W3836) and recognition/incentive (links to W3838)

Sales Enablement/Store-Ops run performance conversations using the scorecard (recognize top performers, coach middle, improve bottom), with fairness and lawful handling of associate-level data (links to VS-84/VS-91)

fields.Participants: Sales Enablement, Analytics (links to VS-28.1), Merchandising (links to VS-01), Store Ops (links to VS-07), In-Store Services (links to VS-09), Finance (links to VS-17.4/VS-101), Pricing (links to VS-01.2/VS-57)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-analyze of "Sales Enablement/Analytics analyze basket" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-identify of "identify attach/basket opportunities" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-report of "report to commercial" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-603 (ensure controlled execution — Selling Performance, Attachment & Clienteling Analytics (PA-124.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Opportunity-blindness risk**: Attach/basket gaps unseen; mitigated by analytics
- **Action-gap risk**: Insights not translated to action; mitigated by playbook/coaching linkage
System Touchpoints: - POS (links to VS-08); ecommerce (links to VS-10); merchandising/pricing (links to VS-01.2/VS-57); in-store services (links to VS-09); merchandise finance (links to VS-101); analytics (links to VS-28.1)

steps.activity: Sales Enablement/Analytics analyze basket (size, units, composition, category mix), conversion (footfall → transaction where measurable), and attach (primary item → accessory/service/link-sell) by store/department/category/region/time, using POS/ecommerce data (links to VS-08/VS-10)

Sales Enablement/Merchandising identify attach/basket opportunities (under-attached categories, missing link-sells, service attach gaps — links to W3846) and translate into playbook/coaching actions (links to W3835/W3836) and promo/pricing actions (links to VS-01.2/VS-14)
Sales Enablement/Finance measure the revenue/margin impact of attach/basket initiatives and report to commercial (links to VS-101/VS-33.2)

fields.Participants: Sales Enablement, Analytics (links to VS-28.1), CRM/Loyalty (links to VS-13.3), Store Ops (links to VS-07), IT (links to VS-27), Data Privacy (links to VS-91)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-measure of "measure clienteling effectiveness" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-report of "report clienteling ROI" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-603 (ensure controlled execution — Selling Performance, Attachment & Clienteling Analytics (PA-124.3).)
- operational: adoption analytics and coaching; operational: RA 10173 governance (links to VS-91)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Low-adoption risk**: Clienteling tool underused; mitigated by adoption analytics and coaching
- **Privacy risk**: Customer-360 analytics mishandled; mitigated by RA 10173 governance (links to VS-91)
System Touchpoints: - CRM/loyalty (links to VS-13.3); POS (links to VS-08); analytics (links to VS-28.1); data privacy (links to VS-91); enablement/mobile (links to W3839/W3844)

steps.activity: Sales Enablement/Analytics/CRM measure clienteling effectiveness: customer-identification rate (loyalty-identified transactions %), associate adoption of the clienteling tool (links to W3844), identified-customer basket/attach/frequency uplift vs anonymous, and tool usage
Sales Enablement/Store-Ops translate clienteling analytics into adoption actions (coaching links to W3836, tool UX fixes links to W3855, identification enablement links to W3845)
Sales Enablement/Analytics report clienteling ROI (revenue uplift from identified customers vs program/tool cost) and ensure lawful data handling throughout (links to VS-91)

Sales Enablement/Trade-Sales identify capture gaps (unidentified trade-pros, low project attach, weak account growth) and translate into trade-pro selling enablement (links to W3837) and program actions (links to VS-43/VS-107)

- System auto-report of "report loyalty-driven selling performance and ROI to commercial/loyalty…" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-603 (ensure controlled execution — Selling Performance, Attachment & Clienteling Analytics (PA-124.3).)
- operational: lifecycle analytics and win-back; operational: RA 10173 governance (links to VS-91)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Member-disengagement risk**: Members enroll but go inactive; mitigated by lifecycle analytics and win-back
- **Privacy risk**: Member behavior analytics mishandled; mitigated by RA 10173 governance (links to VS-91)
System Touchpoints: - Loyalty/CRM (links to VS-13.2/VS-13.3); marketing/promo (links to VS-14/VS-58); POS (links to VS-08); analytics (links to VS-28.1); data privacy (links to VS-91)

steps.activity: Sales Enablement/Loyalty/Analytics measure loyalty-driven selling: member share of revenue/basket, tier behavior, member vs non-member metrics, redemption impact on basket, and member lifecycle (enroll → active → lapsed)

Sales Enablement/Loyalty translate insights into selling actions (associate-driven enrollment links to W3845, targeted offers links to VS-58/VS-14, win-back links to VS-13) and member-experience improvements
Sales Enablement/Analytics report loyalty-driven selling performance and ROI to commercial/loyalty governance (links to VS-33.2/VS-13), with lawful member-data handling (links to VS-91)

fields.Trigger: Reporting cycle; budget cycle (links to W3840)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-measure of "measure enablement program ROI" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-review of "Sales Enablement run program-effectiveness review" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-report of "report enablement ROI and effectiveness to executive" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - operational: controlled measurement and triangulation; operational: ROI reporting
Pain Points / Risks: - **Attribution-difficulty risk**: Hard to isolate enablement impact; mitigated by controlled measurement and triangulation
- **ROI-opacity risk**: Program value unproven → budget cuts; mitigated by ROI reporting
System Touchpoints: - Analytics (links to VS-28.1); finance (links to VS-17.4); L&D (links to VS-19.4); strategy (links to VS-33); governance (links to VS-36)

steps.activity: Sales Enablement/Finance measure enablement program ROI: revenue/margin uplift attributable to enablement (basket/attach/conversion/clienteling lift — links to W3850/W3851), certification coverage impact (links to W3842), and program cost (links to W3840)

Sales Enablement run program-effectiveness review: what's working (which playbooks/coaching/contests/tools drive lift), what's not, and reallocate effort/budget to highest-impact enablement (links to W3840)
Sales Enablement/COO report enablement ROI and effectiveness to executive (links to VS-33.2/VS-36) and translate into strategy/budget actions (links to W3833/W3840)

workflows.name: Customer-Facing Tool / POS / Mobile Experience Optimization for Selling

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-identify of "identify selling-UX friction in the associate tools" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-capture of "Sales Enablement/IT prioritize and deliver UX improvements that reduce" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-measure of "measure the impact of UX changes on selling KPIs" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-603 (ensure controlled execution — Selling Performance, Attachment & Clienteling Analytics (PA-124.3).)
- operational: UX optimization; operational: change management (links to VS-103/VS-14)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Friction-erosion risk**: Slow/clunky tools erode selling time and quality; mitigated by UX optimization
- **Change-disruption risk**: Tool changes disrupt floor routines; mitigated by change management (links to VS-103/VS-14.3)
System Touchpoints: - POS (links to VS-08); mobile (links to VS-75); clienteling (links to W3844); enterprise architecture (links to VS-113); IT ops (links to VS-27); analytics (links to VS-28.1)

steps.activity: Sales Enablement/IT identify selling-UX friction in the associate tools (POS lookup speed, clienteling tool flow, mobile product-info access, quote/estimation tool — links to VS-08/W3844/VS-66/VS-09.2) from associate feedback and analytics

Sales Enablement/IT prioritize and deliver UX improvements that reduce friction and speed selling (faster lookup, one-tap attach, clearer prompts), aligned to enterprise architecture (links to VS-113) and POS/mobile roadmap (links to VS-08/VS-75)
Sales Enablement/Analytics measure the impact of UX changes on selling KPIs (lookup time, attach, conversion — links to W3849) and iterate

steps.activity: Sales Enablement/Store-Ops compile the selling-performance review: basket/conversion/attach (links to W3850), clienteling (links to W3851), trade-pro/B2B (links to W3852), loyalty (links to W3853), enablement ROI (links to W3854), and selling quality (links to W3847), by store/region/category

COO/Sales-Enablement translate the review into commercial actions: merchandising (links to VS-01), pricing/promo (links to VS-01.2/VS-14/VS-57), trade-pro/loyalty programs (links to VS-43/VS-13), store-ops priorities (links to VS-07), and enablement investment (links to W3840) — aligned to the merchandise/commercial plan (links to VS-101/VS-33)
